mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cargo ( booking_id, shipper_id, cargo_type, weight, dimension_length, dimension_width, dimension_height, quantity, description, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, booking_status, hazardous_class, un_number, proper_shipping_name, min_temperature, max_temperature, temperature_unit ) VALUES ( CAST(#{bookingId} AS UUID), CAST(#{shipperId} AS UUID), #{cargoType}, #{weight}, #{dimensionLength}, #{dimensionWidth}, #{dimensionHeight}, #{quantity}, #{description}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{bookingStatus}, #{hazardousClass}, #{unNumber}, #{properShippingName}, #{minTemperature}, #{maxTemperature}, #{temperatureUnit} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, booking_id, shipper_id, cargo_type, weight, dimension_length, dimension_width, dimension_height, quantity, description, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, booking_status, hazardous_class, un_number, proper_shipping_name, min_temperature, max_temperature, temperature_unit, tracking_number FROM cargo WHERE booking_id = CAST(#{bookingId} AS UUID)

SELECT id, booking_id, shipper_id, cargo_type, weight, dimension_length, dimension_width, dimension_height, quantity, description, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, booking_status, hazardous_class, un_number, proper_shipping_name, min_temperature, max_temperature, temperature_unit, tracking_number FROM cargo ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE cargo SET booking_status = #{bookingStatus}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumber} WHERE booking_id = CAST(#{bookingId} AS UUID)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM cargo WHERE booking_id = CAST(#{bookingId} AS UUID)

SELECT id, booking_id, shipper_id, cargo_type, weight, dimension_length, dimension_width, dimension_height, quantity, description, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, booking_status, hazardous_class, un_number, proper_shipping_name, min_temperature, max_temperature, temperature_unit, tracking_number FROM cargo WHERE shipper_id = CAST(#{shipperId} AS UUID) ORDER BY id
